governs: order 4.2 meshes and scoring of the 151 buildings (scripts/phd/main_base151_v1/b151_units.py, b151_score151.py)

units.rule: mesh unit = (cell k, JUDGECHECK-v2 100 m tile t): xy rectangle = tile core [E0, E0+100) x [N0, N0+100) intersected with the ORIGINAL cell k rectangle; units are made for every (k, t) whose rectangle holds >= 1 paired GT point of the 151 buildings (either prior)
units.z_range: [5th percentile of the GT points in the unit - 5 m, max + 5 m] (BASELINES gpu_s1.box_of rule: GT 5 % - 5 m, max + 5 m)
units.views: the cell k training views whose image is covered by the projected unit box (TRAINUNIT tu_cells.coverage > 0); views file = GTJUDGE views format (K of jbgs_calibration.json, W2C)
units.why: the existing mesh rule was made for site boxes of about 100 x 100 m (TRAINUNIT B0 6 TSDF tiles, 8-10 min, 3.7 GB cleanup); a whole cell (up to 240 x 330 m) is several site boxes, so the cell is cut along the 100 m tile grid of the GT points

mesh.model: GS methods: the final iteration-30000 model of cell k (all its Gaussians; render_model keeps the Gaussians inside the unit box); LGDM: see inputs_LGDM
mesh.render: RESCORE render_model.py with the method renderer at the unit views (depth masked to the unit box)
mesh.tsdf: src/phd/streamed_tsdf (voxel 0.05 m, trunc 0.25 m, depth trunc 300 m) via RESCORE mesh_pipeline.prepare, plan auto:10 (tiling changes memory only, not the mesh), order, tile, bounded_merge
mesh.cleanup: RESCORE cleanup.cpp unchanged (shared-edge components, cutoff max(50, 50th-largest), degenerate removed, all vertices inside the rectangle) with the unit rectangle (cos 1, sin 0: u = x, v = -y)
mesh.keep: the unit rectangle lies inside the original cell, so the cell mesh is kept inside the original cell boundary

completeness.rows: JUDGECHECK-v2 analysis/gt_<prior>.npz paired rows of the 151 buildings (b151_gtcheck.py -> OUT/gt/gt151_<prior>.npz)
completeness.distance: GTJUDGE normal_line.measure(scene, xyz, normal, wall) (point + four 5 cm tangent offsets, +-n, roof 10 m / wall 5 m); wall = paired patch kind 2
completeness.within: |s| <= tau of the row; no hit = not within
completeness.main: decision request 1 (recommended, proceeding): each row is scored on the mesh of the unit that contains it (the cell that contains the point)
completeness.literal: also reported: a row of building b (cell c_b) is scored on the mesh of unit (c_b, tile of the row); rows outside c_b therefore have no surface unless that unit mesh reaches them

accuracy.samples: GTJUDGE geometry_add1.sample_normals: 400 / m2, numpy default_rng(0), triangles kept when their centroid is in a sample cell or area > 0.01, samples kept in sample cells
accuracy.sample_cells: 0.5 m cells of the campus grid of the site rule (e0 690700, n0 5335820, nx 1000) that hold >= 1 paired GT row of the prior (site rule: cells holding GT points inside footprint + 2 m)
accuracy.reference: all rows of JUDGECHECK-v2 analysis/gt_<prior>.npz inside the unit rectangle + 1 m (paired or not); radius = median nearest-neighbour spacing of that reference
accuracy.eligible: Euclidean distance to the reference <= 1 m
accuracy.distance: GTJUDGE Cylinder.query along the sample normal (flipped to the nearest reference normal; ALS reference normals up), length 5 m wall / 10 m roof by the nearest reference row
accuracy.owner: RESCORE geometry.columns rule: prism columns of the JUDGECHECK-v2 patches of the unit (geometry_raw, centre + prior_height_m * n, half width 0.125 m, roof 10 m / wall 5 m; ALS tangents as s4_truth_rest), RESCORE prism.cpp
accuracy.assigned_row: the nearest paired row with the same owner patch (GTJUDGE score_new rule); case and building of that row
accuracy.tau: tau of the assigned row; samples without an assigned row: tau of the nearest paired row
accuracy.within: |cylinder distance| <= tau over eligible (and not steep) samples
accuracy.building_of_sample: assigned row building; else the building of the nearest paired row within 1 m

outputs.total: 151 buildings together: per case (0, 1, 2, 4) and all rows: completeness, accuracy, n
outputs.per_building: same per building, n per case, flag n < 200
outputs.groups: experiment buildings (JUDGECHECK-v2 group experiment, 10) vs rest (141)
outputs.twodgs: 2DGS mesh shared by both priors, scored with each prior's rows

differences_from_GTJUDGE: rows = JUDGECHECK-v2 points (0.1 m thinning outside the three sites) instead of the GTJUDGE site rows
tau per row (region and kind) instead of one value per site and kind
sample cells from the paired GT rows instead of footprint + 2 m cells
mesh unit = cell x 100 m tile instead of the site box
